title: Account Switch Guard
summary: Names which account an action runs as, and notices when another tab switched accounts, so nobody posts from the wrong one.
description: When several accounts are signed in, names who the action runs as and who it is not ("Posting as Acme Corp, not Tushar"), and catches a switch made in another tab so the button names the page's account instead of silently acting as the new one.
catches: An account switch made in another tab of the same browser (BroadcastChannel, with a storage-event fallback)
The page's account differing from the most recently active account
Ambiguous action buttons, by naming the acting account on the button
limits: Only sees switches reported through its own channel; switches made elsewhere (another browser, device or app) are invisible
It does not change which session the request is sent with; your onAction decides that
a11y: Mismatch notice sits in an aria-live="polite" region
The action button is described by the identity line via aria-describedby
The highlight animation is skipped when prefers-reduced-motion is set
Avatar colour is decorative (aria-hidden); the account is always named in text
server: The server must act as the account the session actually authenticates, and reject requests whose stated account differs from it.
mistakes: posted from company account by mistake
